A bracket is ordinary prose inside a brace group, not a delimiter of it.

\emph{the extent to which [the instructor's attributes] differ from the backgrounds of [the] students will have a profound effect on the classroom}

\textbf{a [b] c} and \emph{a [[doubly bracketed]] atom} and a note\footnote{see
\emph{[ibid.]} for the full argument}.

\footnote[3]{a numbered note whose body carries [a bracket] as content}
